newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Recticel surges on Brussels bourse.
newsitem.headline: Recticel surges on Brussels bourse.

text.p: Ordinary shares in Belgian foam and foam products maker Recticel climbed sharply on the Brussels bourse to midsession on Wednesday, although traders were at a loss to explain why.
The stock was up 4.8 percent at 440 francs at 1020 GMT, with only one trade reported.
"Maybe someone expects good results," one trader said. "But this is a very illiquid stock so any move is exagerated."
The preferred stock, usually the more liquid of the two issues listed, was one percent up at 510 francs on five moves.
Recticel cut its losses in calendar 1996 to near breakeven and said in March it was optimistic for 1997.
